# EmptyClass

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="info" text="off by default" />

Group: [Architecture](/rules/#architecture) · PhpStorm name: `EmptyClassInspection`

A named class (or trait, or enum) that declares nothing at all — no
properties, constants, methods, used traits or enum cases — is usually dead
weight or an unfinished stub.

## Example

```php{9,10,11,12,20}
<?php
class HasState  { private $count = 0; }
class HasLimit  { const MAX = 10; }
class HasAction { public function go() {} }
trait Greets    { public function hi() {} }
class UsesTrait { use Greets; }
interface Marker {}

class Placeholder {}
class Tagged implements Marker {}
trait Blank {}
enum Mood {}
enum Size { case Small; }

class ParseFailure extends \InvalidArgumentException {}
abstract class Shape { abstract public function area(); }
class Dot extends Shape {}
/** @deprecated use HasState */
class OldStub {}
class Fatal extends \Error {}
$x = new class {};
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 9: This class declares no members; remove it or give it a purpose.</li>
<li>line 10: This class declares no members; remove it or give it a purpose.</li>
<li>line 11: This class declares no members; remove it or give it a purpose.</li>
<li>line 12: This enum declares no cases or methods.</li>
<li>line 20: This class declares no members; remove it or give it a purpose.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "EmptyClass": {
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore EmptyClass

/**
 * @noinspection EmptyClassInspection
 */
```
